The '''Suicide Peak''' was a variation of the [[Pop'N'Drop]], and was and Outlaw level [[Bank (swoopchasing)|Bank]] fence used in [[swoopchasing]]. The initial bank approach was between fifteen and twenty-five degrees, and the opposing bank dropped twenty to twenty-five meters. The distance between the two banks was fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="BSS" />
